_comment: Bible des personnages. Une description visuelle ecrite UNE fois, que
chaque prompt d'image reprend mot pour mot des qu'un alias apparait dans
la page. C'est la constance du TEXTE qui fait la constance de l'image :
ne pas reformuler une fiche sans regenerer les images concernees.
Les couleurs ne nomment que la palette HGR de l'Apple II -- noir, blanc,
violet, vert, bleu, orange. Dire 'gris' produisait du bleu a la
conversion, de facon coherente mais pas voulue.
`source` : `livre` = tire du texte original, `portage` = choix assume.

characters.look: THE HERO, the young paladin (whenever he appears, always identical): a lean, muscular human adventurer with short BLACK hair and an uncovered head, wearing a sleeveless ORANGE leather jerkin with a wide belt, his muscular arms BARE, an ORANGE leather backpack, and a straight WHITE sword SHEATHED in its scabbard at his left hip -- both hands empty and at rest. He is a traveller, not a man on the attack: he draws the sword only when the scene itself is a fight. Seen three-quarters from behind so the face stays hidden.
characters.scale: the size reference: an adult man, about six feet tall

characters.look: GROGNARD, a rough, plain, heavy-set traveller in worn ORANGE-brown clothes, unarmed and unremarkable. He is secretly a paladin, but it must NOT show: draw him with NO cross and NO sword in every image -- EXCEPT the single revelation scene whose text asks whether a cross is embroidered on his clothes and where a sword appears at his side; only there, show the WHITE embroidered cross and the plain WHITE sword.

STRATAGUS, the evil sorcerer: tall and skeletally gaunt, wrapped in a BLACK toga embroidered with VIOLET motifs that seem to writhe; hollow face, long thin hands, no weapon. Drawn with THICK heavy strokes throughout -- no fine lines, no thin hatching; every stroke must stay readable at 280x192.
characters.scale: a head taller than the hero, but half his width

characters.look: GAYOLARD, the good wizard: a short plump man, WHITE tunic and plain linen trousers, bare-headed, with completely clean hands -- he is found at his potter's wheel in his garden, but clay appears only on the wheel and pots, never on his skin; he carries no staff and no weapon.
POMPATARTE, the merchant: heavy-set and prosperous, ORANGE tunic over a round belly, rings on his fingers, a sly smile; his dark hair worn in thick braids, and his beard plaited into braids as well.
characters.scale: the hero's height but twice his width

characters.look: THE GARDEN MASTER: a lean man in long GREEN robes, bare-headed, a WHITE silver flower-shaped amulet on a chain at his neck, earth on his hands.

THE WOLF MASTER: a burly man dressed like a forest ranger -- GREEN tunic and leggings under a shaggy WHITE-and-BLACK wolf pelt slung over one shoulder -- iron-hard face, short BLACK beard, a WHITE silver wolf-head amulet hanging on his chest, a plain WHITE sword at his side.
characters.scale: a head taller and much broader than the hero

characters.look: THE MISTRESS OF BIRDS: a beautiful woman seated on a stone pedestal in a WHITE gown, long dark hair, a SILVER bird-shaped amulet at her throat; eagles and herons walk freely around her. Drawn simply with THICK bold strokes and large flat shapes -- no fine detail, no delicate linework.
THE SPIDER MASTER: a gaunt figure in tattered BLACK robes, a spider-shaped amulet at his neck, holding a slim glinting wand whose tip is smeared GREEN with poison.
THE FROG MASTER, a toad of a man: squat and wide-mouthed, damp GREEN-mottled skin, bulging eyes set high on the head, webbed fingers, a frog-shaped amulet at his neck, robes the colour of pond water.
characters.scale: shorter than the hero, twice as wide

characters.look: THE PARROT: a large talking parrot with ORANGE, GREEN and BLUE plumage, perched and watching with one round eye.
